description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Photovoltaics is named as a key technology in Austria's future energy supply mix.
description_problem: The source states that PV contributes to Austria's future energy supply, not that PV contributes to Austria as a geographic entity.
audit_notes: A better target would be FUTURE_ENERGY_SUPPLY or ENERGY_MIX rather than ÖSTERREICH.

description: The Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy (ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE) is a guiding framework dedicated to the expansion and strategic support of photovoltaics (PHOTOVOLTAIK) in Austria, providing framework, targets, and measures to support the further expansion and integration of photovoltaics.
description_problem: The relationship is source-supported, but GraphRAG left both relation type and modality unspecified.
audit_notes: The strategy explicitly provides objectives and measures for PV expansion. A suitable type would be SUPPORTS or SETS_TARGET_FOR.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ASSOCIATED_WITH] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy concerns the deployment of photovoltaics in Austria.
audit_notes: The document explicitly concerns photovoltaic development. ASSOCIATED_WITH is broad but acceptable.

description: PV-Anlage (PV systems) are a primary and central form of Photovoltaik (photovoltaics) installations.
description_problem: The taxonomic statement that PV-ANLAGE is a specific form of PHOTOVOLTAIK is reasonable, but it is not expressed as a formal relationship in the source.
audit_notes: A more precise controlled relationship would be INSTANCE_OR_FORM_OF rather than UNSPECIFIED.

description: The ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE (Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy) is a national policy instrument in Austria that is associated with the development and measures of Austria's photovoltaic (PV) market and provides guidelines for PV expansion in the country.
description_problem: The strategy applies to Austria; Austria does not apply to or govern the strategy in the direction shown.
audit_notes: A better representation is ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE APPLIES_TO ÖSTERREICH.

description: The Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy (ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE) is applicable to Austria's national PV development and pertains to Austria's national solar policy.
description_problem: The endpoints and direction are appropriate, but the relation type and modality are unspecified.
audit_notes: A suitable controlled relationship is APPLIES_TO with EXPLICIT_FACT modality.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Expansion of photovoltaics leads to production peaks, which are already challenging to fully absorb in the public grid.
description_problem: CONTRIBUTES_TO is acceptable, although CAUSES_OR_INCREASES would express the relationship more precisely.
audit_notes: The source explicitly discusses PV generation peaks and difficulties absorbing them in the public grid.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ASSOCIATED_WITH] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Photovoltaics is the general technology class under which photovoltaic installations are a specific deployment form.
description_problem: The relationship is a reasonable taxonomic interpretation rather than an explicit source claim.
audit_notes: Photovoltaic installations are a deployment form of photovoltaics, but EXPLICIT_FACT overstates the source status.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The NIP identifies and supports area potentials on buildings, infrastructures, and open spaces for PV installation.
description_problem: The NIP supports PV planning and identifies PV potential, but the description broadly attributes building, infrastructure and open-space area potentials to the NIP.
audit_notes: The central NIP–PV connection is valid, but its stated scope is broader than the directly supporting text.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The energy transition in Austria requires the expansion of photovoltaics as a key renewable energy source.
description_problem: The source supports the statement, but REQUIRES is more accurate than SUPPORTS.
audit_notes: The energy transition is described as requiring renewable-energy and photovoltaic expansion.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Expansion of photovoltaics contributes to achieving the estimated technical potential of 41 TWh by 2040.
description_problem: The source states that the estimated PV potential is 41 TWh by 2040, but does not explicitly phrase PV as contributing to its own potential.
audit_notes: A more precise representation would connect the NIP or Austria to the 41 TWh target using HAS_TARGET or IDENTIFIES_POTENTIAL.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Energy communities are identified as a basis for communal PV expansion.
audit_notes: The source explicitly describes energy communities as a basis for communal photovoltaic expansion.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Photovoltaics is identified as a central pillar (wesentliche Säule) for attaining the 2030 renewable electricity target.
audit_notes: The source explicitly identifies photovoltaics as an important pillar for achieving the renewable-electricity objective.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=SCENARIO] PV development is necessary to achieve the 21 TWh 2030 generation target.
audit_notes: The 21 TWh requirement for 2030 is presented within the Transition 2040 scenario, so SCENARIO is appropriate.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] PV is described as the most decentralized form of renewable power generation, supporting decentralized energy use in households and businesses.
description_problem: The source describes PV as highly decentralized, but the claim that it supports household and business energy use is a synthesized interpretation.
audit_notes: The decentralization connection is reasonable, but EXPLICIT_FACT is too strong.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Photovoltaics is expected to deliver at least 11 TWh of new generation capacity by 2030 toward national targets.
description_problem: The description calls 11 TWh generation capacity. TWh measures energy generation, not installed capacity.
audit_notes: The numerical target is source-supported, but the generated description confuses energy and capacity.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Achieving climate neutrality by 2040 is associated with major PV expansion; PV is described as a central pillar of Austria's energy system in 2040.
audit_notes: The source explicitly presents PV expansion as a major component of achieving Austria's 2040 climate-neutrality objective.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=RECOMMENDATION] These zones are intended to make it easier and faster to expand renewable energy installations such as photovoltaics.
description_problem: The acceleration areas originate from an EU legal-policy provision rather than merely a general recommendation.
audit_notes: SUPPORTS is suitable, but LEGAL_REQUIREMENT or PLANNED_ACTION would describe the modality more accurately.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The metric reports PV electricity generation for 2023.
audit_notes: The source explicitly reports 6.3 TWh of Austrian PV electricity generation in 2023.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Digitalization of market communication enables PV system operators to participate, directly or in aggregated form, in various electricity and flexibility markets.
description_problem: The source states that digital market communication enables PV system operators to participate in markets, not that it supports the PHOTOVOLTAIK technology itself.
audit_notes: The better target is PV-ANLAGENBETREIBER:INNEN or another market-participant stakeholder entity.

source: FÖRDERPROGRAMM MUSTER- & LEUCHTTURMPROJEKTE PHOTOVOLTAIK DES KLIMA- UND ENERGIEFONDS
description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The Climate and Energy Fund's funding programme supports photovoltaic innovation and project deployment.
description_problem: The description should avoid claiming specific innovation or deployment outcomes beyond the stated purpose of the funding programme.
audit_notes: The Climate and Energy Fund programme explicitly supports photovoltaic demonstration and lighthouse projects.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=REGULATES] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The Eco-design Directive, expanded to a regulation, applies to and is used to regulate photovoltaic systems.
description_problem: The source presents expansion or application of eco-design requirements as a proposed or planned measure, not simply as an already established fact.
audit_notes: REGULATES is appropriate, but PROPOSAL or PLANNED_ACTION would be more accurate than EXPLICIT_FACT.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONSTRAINS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Comprehensive and complex approval procedures hinder rapid PV expansion.
audit_notes: The source explicitly identifies complex approval procedures as a barrier to rapid photovoltaic expansion.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ASSOCIATED_WITH] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The flexibility studies of E-Control are a basis for further implementation actions for flexibility involving PV.
description_problem: ASSOCIATED_WITH is valid but less informative than SUPPORTS or PROVIDES_EVIDENCE_FOR.
audit_notes: E-Control flexibility studies are explicitly referenced as a basis for further flexibility-related implementation.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=SUPPORTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Quality-assurance measures in ecological and technical processes contribute to establishing photovoltaics as a widely accepted standard technology.
description_problem: Quality-assurance measures are presented as recommended or planned actions rather than completed factual effects.
audit_notes: The relationship is supported, but RECOMMENDATION or PLANNED_ACTION is more accurate than EXPLICIT_FACT.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The metric concerns annual photovoltaic capacity expansion in Austria for 2022.
audit_notes: The source explicitly reports more than 1 GW of new photovoltaic capacity in Austria in 2022.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The metric concerns annual photovoltaic capacity expansion in Austria for 2023.
audit_notes: The source explicitly reports approximately 2.5 GW of photovoltaic capacity additions in Austria in 2023.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The amount of energy generated by photovoltaics in Austria in 2023 is measured at 6.3 TWh.
audit_notes: The source explicitly reports approximately 6.3 TWh of photovoltaic electricity generation in Austria in 2023.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] PV is described as a fundamental pillar for Austria's electricity supply in 2040, reaching about 30%.
description_problem: The 30% value concerns a future 2040 target or projected contribution, not a present factual measurement.
audit_notes: The relationship is source-supported, but TARGET or SCENARIO is more accurate than EXPLICIT_FACT.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] By 2023, photovoltaics accounted for roughly 10% of Austria's final electricity consumption.
audit_notes: The source explicitly states that PV supplied nearly 10% of Austria's final electricity consumption at the end of 2023.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] In 2023, photovoltaics covered about 2% of Austria's total energy demand.
audit_notes: The source explicitly states that PV covered approximately 2% of Austria's total energy demand in 2023.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=SCENARIO] PV expansion is projected to provide 20% of total Austrian energy supply in 2040.
audit_notes: The source explicitly projects that photovoltaic installations will provide around 20% of Austria's total energy supply in 2040.

target: PHOTOVOLTAIK-AUSBAU BIS 2040 — DURCHSCHNITTLICH 2 GW PRO JAHR
description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The expansion of photovoltaics is the subject of the planned target of an average 2 GW annual deployment to 2040.
description_problem: The average annual expansion rate is a future requirement or target, not a present explicit fact.
audit_notes: HAS_TARGET with TARGET or SCENARIO modality would be more precise than CONTRIBUTES_TO with EXPLICIT_FACT.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] PV installations are highly visible and their broad societal presence is noted as a factual characteristic.
description_problem: Broad visibility is a qualitative characteristic of PV installations, not a measurement used to quantify photovoltaics.
audit_notes: HAS_CHARACTERISTIC or ASSOCIATED_WITH would be more suitable than MEASURED_BY.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=MEASURED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The current share of photovoltaics in Austria’s electricity supply is approximately 10%.
description_problem: The source connects the approximately 10% value to the end of 2023, while the generated relationship calls it current without retaining the year.
audit_notes: The numerical value is supported, but its temporal context was weakened.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=SCENARIO] PV expansion is identified as enabling 20% of total energy supply if the energy system is sufficiently electrified.
description_problem: This relationship substantially duplicates another 20% by 2040 PV-energy-supply relationship.
audit_notes: The claim is supported, but duplicated target entities create redundant relationships.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Expanding photovoltaics is stated to contribute to a sustainable and affordable electricity supply.
description_problem: The description says PV expansion contributes to sustainable and affordable electricity, but the stored edge points in the opposite direction.
audit_notes: The correct direction is PHOTOVOLTAIK CONTRIBUTES_TO NACHHALTIGE UND GÜNSTIGE STROMVERSORGUNG.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The expansion of photovoltaics strengthens Austria's energy independence.
description_problem: The source says renewable-energy and PV expansion strengthen energy independence, but the stored edge points from energy independence to PV.
audit_notes: The direction should run from PHOTOVOLTAIK to ENERGIEUNABHÄNGIGKEIT ÖSTERREICHS.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Increasing domestic value creation and jobs are identified as outcomes of PV expansion.
description_problem: Jobs and domestic value creation are described as outcomes of PV expansion, but the stored edge points from jobs to PV.
audit_notes: The direction should run from PHOTOVOLTAIK to ARBEITSPLÄTZE DURCH PHOTOVOLTAIK.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ALIAS_OF] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The strategy highlights the speed and methodology of PV expansion as key criteria for energy transition success.
description_problem: The strategy is not an alias of the speed and methodology of PV expansion. These are entirely different concepts.
audit_notes: The source discusses the importance of expansion speed and methodology, but it does not support an ALIAS_OF relationship.

source: FÜHRENDE FORSCHUNGSEINRICHTUNGEN IM BEREICH DER PHOTOVOLTAIK
description: [RELATION_TYPE=ALIAS_OF] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Leading research institutions in PV are described as a major part of the overall field of PV research institutions.
description_problem: Leading PV research institutions are not aliases of the broader category of all PV research institutions.
audit_notes: A subset or PART_OF relationship might be defensible, but ALIAS_OF is not supported.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=AMENDS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] RED III is stated as amending Directive 2018/2001.
audit_notes: RED III explicitly amends Directive (EU) 2018/2001.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=APPLIES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Regulatory requirements and obligations aim to mobilize already-used or sealed surfaces for PV installations.
description_problem: Mobilising sealed or previously used surfaces is presented as a policy objective or proposed measure, not merely as an existing fact.
audit_notes: APPLIES_TO is acceptable, but PLANNED_ACTION or RECOMMENDATION is more accurate than EXPLICIT_FACT.

source: KLARE ZIELE DER BUNDESLÄNDER UND GEMEINDEN
description: [RELATION_TYPE=APPLIES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Clarity of targets is needed for Austrian municipalities to enable necessary PV expansion.
description_problem: The source says clear municipal and state targets are required. It does not state that abstract targets apply to the entity GEMEINDE in this direction.
audit_notes: A better relationship is GEMEINDE HAS_TARGET PV-AUSBAUZIEL.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ASSOCIATED_WITH] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The training offensive in qualification alliances is part of the broad support for energy-transition relevant apprenticeships under Just Transition.
audit_notes: The source explicitly connects the Just Transition training initiative with training offensives in qualification alliances.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=ASSOCIATED_WITH] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] E-Control is identified as a significant actor in grid expansion and operation in the strategy.
description_problem: E-Control is referenced through grid-connection actions and flexibility studies, but its description as a significant strategy actor is a synthesis.
audit_notes: The association is reasonable, but EXPLICIT_FACT overstates the directness of the claim.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=BENEFITS_FROM] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The agricultural sector gains new income opportunities and improved land efficiency through Agri-PV installations.
audit_notes: The source explicitly states that Agri-PV provides agriculture with new income opportunities and improves land-use efficiency.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CAN_USE] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] [STATUS=PLANNED] Active customers will be able to jointly use energy generated in communal installations.
description_problem: The output combines EXPLICIT_FACT with STATUS=PLANNED, creating ambiguity about whether the arrangement is existing or prospective.
audit_notes: The active-customer use relationship is supported, but its legal or implementation status requires more precise representation.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONSTRAINS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Environmental Impact Assessment requirements are referenced as relevant to permitting and deploying photovoltaic installations.
description_problem: Environmental assessment requirements are relevant to permitting, but describing UVP categorically as constraining photovoltaics is an interpretation.
audit_notes: A more neutral relationship such as APPLIES_TO or REGULATES would be preferable.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONSTRAINS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] PV generation peaks cannot be completely absorbed by the public electricity grid, representing a technical constraint.
audit_notes: The source explicitly describes difficulties absorbing photovoltaic generation peaks in the public electricity grid.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Austrian companies are noted for exporting innovative PV technologies/components globally.
description_problem: The source describes Austrian companies as exporting PV technologies and components. The stored edge incorrectly runs from the export activity to the companies.
audit_notes: A better relationship is ÖSTERREICHISCHE UNTERNEHMEN EXPORTS PV-TECHNOLOGIE UND KOMPONENTEN.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=CONTRIBUTES_TO] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The strategy identifies photovoltaic expansion as a key pillar for achieving climate neutrality in Austria by 2040.
description_problem: The strategy identifies measures intended to support climate neutrality, but the strategy document itself does not directly cause climate neutrality.
audit_notes: SUPPORTS or SETS_TARGET_FOR would be more cautious than CONTRIBUTES_TO, and the 2040 outcome is a target.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=FUNDS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] The Climate and Energy Fund co-financed PV expansion in 2023.
description_problem: The source attributes approximately EUR 600 million jointly to the EAG and the Climate and Energy Fund; it does not allocate the entire amount to the Fund alone.
audit_notes: The funding connection is valid, but the exact amount cannot be independently assigned to this single endpoint.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=FUNDS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] 600 million EUR in PV support in 2023 were disbursed under the EAG.
description_problem: The approximately EUR 600 million is jointly associated with the EAG and Climate and Energy Fund, not exclusively disbursed under the EAG.
audit_notes: GraphRAG split a combined funding statement into separate edges that each appear to claim the complete amount.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=HAS_TARGET] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Austria has set the official target of 100 percent renewable electricity on a national balance by 2030.
audit_notes: The source explicitly states Austria's objective of nationally balanced 100% renewable electricity consumption by 2030.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=HAS_TARGET] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Austria’s PV expansion potential of 41 TWh by 2040 is determined within the ÖNIP.
description_problem: The 41 TWh figure is identified as PV expansion potential in the NIP, not necessarily as an adopted Austrian target.
audit_notes: IDENTIFIES_POTENTIAL or HAS_POTENTIAL would be more accurate than HAS_TARGET.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=IMPLEMENTED] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] [STATUS=ADOPTED] The grid connection action plan was published and is led by E-Control in July 2023.
description_problem: The action plan did not implement E-Control. E-Control published or developed the action plan.
audit_notes: The correct direction is E-CONTROL IMPLEMENTED_OR_PUBLISHED AKTIONSPLAN NETZANSCHLUSS.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=IMPLEMENTED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Financial deductions for ground-mounted PV installations are implemented by the Renewable Expansion Act (EAG).
audit_notes: The source supports the connection between the EAG and financial deductions affecting ground-mounted PV installations.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=IMPLEMENTED_BY] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] Financial premiums for innovative PV system types are implemented via the Renewable Expansion Act (EAG).
audit_notes: The source supports EAG premiums or additional support for innovative photovoltaic system forms.

description: [RELATION_TYPE=IMPLEMENTS] [MODALITY=EXPLICIT_FACT] [STATUS=ONGOING] Austria is an official signatory of the Solar-Charta as of April 2024.
description_problem: Being an official signatory to the Solar Charter does not necessarily mean that Austria implements the Charter as a programme.
audit_notes: SIGNED or PARTICIPATES_IN would be more accurate than IMPLEMENTS.
